subtitle: Tier 1 Final — 12 cumulative questions covering lessons 1-10. Pass with 10/12 (instead of 8/10) to unlock Tier 2.

blocks.title: About this final
blocks.content:
This is a TIER FINAL — a cumulative check that you've absorbed the foundation of Tier 1. It's the gate to Tier 2 (Chart Reading).

The questions cover material from all 10 Tier 1 lessons. If you struggle on questions about a specific topic, that's a signal to review that lesson before retrying.

Higher pass threshold than regular lessons: 10/12 required. The 10 lessons in Tier 1 are the survival foundation — getting these wrong in real trading is expensive. Better to redo the final than to advance with gaps.

rows: Three completely different battlefields — know which one you're on
The broker shapes every trade you ever take; pick on fundamentals, not marketing
Default to limit; OCO for exits; reduce-only on stops

Real cost of execution; 15-20% of gross profit can disappear silently
1-2% rule is mathematical survival, not conservatism
Isolated by default; cross only with explicit reason
FOMO/revenge/tilt destroy more accounts than bad strategies
Skip phases and pay tuition with real money

blocks.content:
If you pass the quiz at 10/12 or better, Tier 2 (Chart Reading) unlocks — candle anatomy, support/resistance, trendlines, structure, multi-timeframe.

If you don't pass, the explanations will show you which Tier 1 areas need more time. Re-take after reviewing. There's no shame in taking the final 2-3 times — these concepts are load-bearing for everything that follows.

blocks.title: Before you start the final
blocks.content: Take 5 minutes to quickly scan the headlines of lessons 1-10 in the path view. Refresh the structure in your head. The quiz isn't tricky but it does assume you can connect concepts across lessons. Then click "Take the quiz" below.
